model.scope: Structurally inspect one proposed bounded Python recipe entry against the current active registry without loading or executing its implementation.
model.evidence: Require a live read-only observer receipt binding the six caller-declared source, contract, parameter, and adversarial-test files to their current byte digests and non-executing JavaScript/JSON parse results.
model.truthBoundary: Observed bytes and parseability remove trust in caller-supplied file-presence and digest claims. The observer does not reproduce test claims, establish semantic safety, identify a signer, prove consent, or complete human review.
model.staging: Emit a candidate entry, hypothetical next-registry digest, and explicit activation gaps. No promotion function exists; activation still requires an explicit reviewed registry source change, full regression, fresh Foundry manifest, and fresh host authorization.
